result:
I changed the saved-metric discovery in `posthog/temporal/experiments/activities.py` so the daily job fingerprints the same config the readers do. I did not run any tests and did not add one.

**What changed:** the daily discovery used to hash `saved_metric.query` as stored, without the per-experiment breakdowns. It now hashes `_merge_saved_metric_breakdowns(saved_metric.query, exp_to_saved_metric.metadata)`. That helper is in `products/experiments/backend/temporal/metric_resolution.py` and is the same merge the timeseries sync, the cold-start fallback and the metric-execution activity use. I added an import of it to `activities.py`.

**Why this fixes it:** the writer and the readers now hash the same config, so results filed for a saved metric with breakdowns are found under the hash the readers look up. The empty-breakdowns case from the earlier fix still hashes the same way.

I made no test changes, so this fix has no regression test yet. A natural one would build an experiment with a saved-metric link that has real breakdowns. It would check that the fingerprint from discovery equals the one `timeseries_sync` computes.
